description: Call when a Lode fact looks wrong or out of date, for example when the vendor's own page says otherwise. A person checks the report against the vendor's page before anything changes. Lode keeps only these fields, the time, the kind of client and an anonymous caller code.

area.description: Which part, one of: sync, pricing, regions, requirements, limitations, connection, other

reason.description: One of: wrong, outdated, missing, source-broken (default wrong)

name: report_error
title: Report a wrong fact
